coordinates: objmap world units (same as the game): x grows east, z grows south, y is height; origin at the map centre; the playable map spans x -5000..5000 and z -4000..4000.

spawns.note: Eventide Island, where you arrive with nothing and must clear the island to leave.
Hyrule Castle Lockup. Unlike other Stalnoxes it is there day and night; beating it opens the chest with the Hylian Shield.
Champions' Ballad: Lake Darman, during EX Champion Daruk's Song. Doesn't count toward the Medal of Honor: Talus.
Champions' Ballad: East Barrens, during EX Champion Urbosa's Song; back after every Blood Moon once beaten. Doesn't count toward the Medal of Honor: Molduga.
Master Mode only: not on Normal Mode files.
Ploymus Mountain: the Lynel Sidon sends you to for Shock Arrows. The game swaps in a second actor once Vah Ruta's quest reaches the mountain; it is the same fight. Never changes colour.

Coliseum Ruins. The game places one Lynel per colour here and shows one: Red, Blue-Maned, White-Maned or Silver as more Divine Beasts are freed (BattleArena_Level1–4), each a tier higher on Master Mode (Blue-Maned up to Golden). Its colour follows that, not the world level.
Hyrule Castle, First Gatehouse. Its colour doesn't rise with the world level.
Hyrule Castle, Second Gatehouse. Its colour doesn't rise with the world level.
